evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moved directly to logistics after confirming availability.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns were raised by the customer to probe deeper on.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep never offered a choice of days or compared pricing across day options. Customer selected Tuesday the 13th and rep confirmed it; no value-day discussion occurred.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: No rate lock or deposit discussion. Rep moved directly to booking confirmation: 'Okay, done.' No explicit ask for the business was made.

top_strength: Brianne gathered comprehensive logistics details about the move (addresses, floor level, freight elevator access, pod contents, apartment size) and anchored an accurate estimate range of $699–$907 based on the specifics.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire consultative spine: no two-concerns question, no promises delivered, no value-day discussion, no rate-lock framing, and no explicit ask for the business — the customer booked herself after probing was done, and Brianne confirmed it reactively rather than closing the sale intentionally.
